paite: David in Israel mite lak a mi teltuam singthum akaikhawm nawn hi.
heading: Jerusalem A Thukhun Bawm Laklutna / (1 Kro 13.1-14; 15.25-16.6,43)

paite: Huchi in David athou a, Judah gam a Baale a pan cherubte tung a tuang sepaihte' TOUPA min aputsak uh Pathian bawm latou ding in akiang a mi om tengteng toh akuan uhi.
Pathian bawm kangtalai thak ah akoih ua, mual tung a om Abinadab inn a pan alakhia uh. Abinadab tapa Uzzah leh Ahio in kangtalai thak ahawl uhi.
Abinadab inn a pan Pathian bawm alakhia ua; Pathian bawm ma ah Ahio apai hi.
David leh Israel mi tengteng in TOUPA ma ah thil ging thei chi tuamtuam meilah sing a bawl leh kaihgingte, pekgingte, khuangtate, pengkul bineite, dakkhutbette atum uhi.
Nakon a buhphual atun un, bawng in ahoisak ziak in Uzzah in Pathian bawm asawk a, alen hi.
Uzzah tung ah TOUPA hehna akuang a, athilhihdiklouh ziak in Pathian in huai ah athat a, Pathian bawm kiang ah asita hi.
TOUPA hehna Uzzah tung a apuahzak ziak in David alungkim kei a, huai mun Perez-uzzah asa a, tuni tan in ahi lai hi.
Huai ni in David in TOUPA alauta hi. "Bangchi in TOUPA bawm ka kiang ahong tung theita dia?" achi hi.
David in TOUPA bawm David khua a amah kiang ah asuan nuam kei hi. Himahleh David in Git mi Obed-edom inn ah akoih zawta hi.
Git mi Obed-edom inn ah kha thum TOUPA bawm a-om hi. Huchi in Obed-edom leh a-inkuan tengteng TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.

"Pathian bawm ziak in, Obed-edom inkuan leh aneih-le-lam tengteng TOUPA'N avualzawl," chi in kumpipa David ahilh uh. Huchi in David in Obed-edom inn a pan Pathian bawm, David ah kipaktak in ava lata hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA bawm zawng mite'n kal guk asuantak un bawngtal leh gan vak thau alan hi.
TOUPA ma ah atheihtawp in David alam a, puanmalngat puanak asilh hi.
Huchi in David leh Israel mi tengteng in kikou zuazua leh pengkul mut kawm in TOUPA bawm alatouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA bawm David khua a alut lai in, Saul tanu Mikal in tohlet a pan ana en a, TOUPA ma a David tawm leh lam amu a, alungtang in asimmohta hi.
Huchi in TOUPA bawm alalut ua, akoihna dia David in akaih, puanin sung a amun ding ah akoihta uhi. David in ToUPA ma ah halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan hi.
David in halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alat khit in sepaihte' TOUPA min in mite avualzawl hi.
Mi tengteng anumei apasal michih tanghou phel khat leh sa bak khat leh grep gah phoukeu bawm khat chiat apia hi. Huchi in michih ama inn lam chiat ah apaita uh.

Hiai zoh in a-inkuante vualzawl ding in David apaikik hi. David dawn ding in Saul tanu Mikal ahong pawt a, "Tuni in Israel kumpipa thupi hi na mai e, migina lou, zumna thei lou kisuahkhete bang mai in tuni in asikha nungakte mitmuh in akisuahkhia a," ana chi hi.
David in Mikal kiang ah, "Na pa leh a-inkuante tengteng sang a kei hon tel, TOUPA, Israelte tung a kumpipa dia hon seppa TOUPA ma ah ahi ka lam. Huaiziak in TOUPA ma ah nuamsa in ka om ding hi.
Hiai sang mah in leng ka zumpihhuai lai ding. Keimah mitmuh in leng ka sithuai lai ding. Himahleh huai sikha nungak na gente pahtawi in ka om ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Saul tanu Mikal in asih ni tanpha in ta anei kei hi.
